Treat it like one. And remember: your legal protection shouldn’t start after someone steals or misuses your digital product. It should be part of your business from the beginning. What exactly IS a digital product? Let me break down every type — with examples. If you've been seeing people talk about 'selling digital products' and wondering what they're actually selling — this is for you. A digital product is anything you create once and sell repeatedly — delivered instantly online, no shipping, no inventory, no returns. Here are the main types: 📄 EBOOKS & GUIDES — PDFs that teach something specific. 'Beginner's Guide to Instagram,' '30-Day Content Plan,' 'How to Start Affiliate Marketing.' Sell for $7–$47. Create in Canva for free. 🎨 TEMPLATES — Pre-made designs buyers customize. Instagram templates, planners, resumes, business cards. Sell for $9–$97. Create in Canva. 🎓 COURSES & WORKSHOPS — Video or written lessons teaching a skill. Can sell for $47–$997+. Host on Stan Store or Beacons. 📦 DONE-FOR-YOU PRODUCTS (PLR/MRR) — Products already created that you can resell. Perfect for beginners who aren't ready to create from scratch yet. 📋 PLANNERS, WORKBOOKS & PRINTABLES — Fillable or printable pages. Budget planners, habit trackers, goal workbooks. Sell for $5–$37. These get the most saves and shares on social. The best part? You don't have to create anything to start. You can begin with a done-for-you product while you're still learning — then create your own once you understand what your audience actually wants. Save this.
